configuration.measurement: tracemalloc peak plus Packed native memory; source graph built before tracing

limits: One host and one sample; elapsed time is under tracemalloc and is diagnostic only.
The pre-existing source graph is outside the traced allocation interval.
Native budget is a cap, not allocated or resident memory; native allocation and RSS are reported separately.
This is not recursive extension throughput, durability, end-to-end process RSS, or billion-vertex qualification.
